description: Where did this Solana wallet's money go? Lists its SOL, USDC, USDT and token transfers out (swaps excluded), resolves Relay bridge deposits to the receiving wallet on the other chain, marks exchanges and service wallets where the trail ends, and shows what the recipients hold now. Use it for drained or hacked wallets, dev wallets after a launch, or a whale moving funds. Optional since (ISO date) limits it to money that moved after that time. Returns a link to the full trail with every transaction.

since.description: Optional ISO date or date-time (UTC), e.g. 2026-11-24 or 2026-11-24T06:40Z

name: follow_the_money
title: Follow the money from a Solana wallet
